summary.intent: Review and update codebase documentation, identify E2E testing candidates, capture improvement todos, add technical debt phases to the roadmap, and begin discussing/planning those phases using the GSD workflow manager.
summary.outcome: Captured 6 E2E/testing todos, added 5 new phases (28-32) to the v1.1 roadmap, discussed and created CONTEXT.md for phases 28, 29, and started 30; launched background planning/execution agents for phases 28 and 29; created two PRs (FSM1/cipher-box#380, FSM1/cipher-box#381).

repo: AES-CTR streaming mode is used for media files >256KB; GCM is used for files <256KB — selection logic in streaming-crypto.service.ts
A Service Worker at decrypt-sw.ts intercepts /decrypt-stream/* URLs and handles HTTP Range requests for seeking
deleteTestAccount() helper exists in tests/sdk-e2e/src/fixtures/test-harness.ts but only recovery.spec.ts actually calls it — 11 of 12 specs leave orphaned test accounts
There are 139 console.* calls across 29 files in apps/web/src/ — hooks.ts alone has 34 (Web3Auth debug logging)
11 .catch(() => {}) patterns silently swallow unpinFromIpfs failures across bin.service.ts, useFileOperations.ts, useFileVersions.ts, ReplaceFileDialog.tsx, useDropUpload.ts
RepublishService.unenrollIpns() exists at apps/api/src/republish/republish.service.ts:255 but has no REST endpoint — a TODO at folder.service.ts:513 explicitly notes this was deferred to Phase 14
